title: Read-frame configuration relation
statement: Let $c$ and $d$ be configurations of an $m$-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and states in the disjoint union of read phases and optional Boolean values, and let $r,s$ be work-tape indices. The configuration $d$ is related to $c$ when there are a state label $l$, an input-head position $ip$, a tape content function $f$, and integers $p,q$ such that $d$ has state $l$, input-head position $ip$, tape $s$ replaced by $f$, head positions first updated at $s$ to $p$ and then at $r$ to $q$, and the same output as $c$; moreover, both $p$ and $q$ lie between $-1$ and the number of binary digits of the input length plus one, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $c,d$ are configurations with $m$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and the stated state type.
The head position $p$ satisfies $-1\le p\le |\mathrm{bits}(n+1)|$, where $n$ is the input length.
